Teacher notes & sources

This activity uses simplified everyday scenarios for Entry 3 ESOL learners. Discuss the action, not the person’s appearance. Freedom comes with responsibility for other people’s rights. Legal restrictions can apply to speech, protest and behaviour.

Music card: Playing music at 3 AM is not automatically a crime. In this scenario, a formal council notice has been issued and is being ignored. This makes the intended answer clear. Noise procedures vary across the UK; the council guidance below applies to England.

Sources: Freedom of belief · Freedom of expression · Peaceful assembly · Noise notices · Traffic lights · Litter

Keyboard: Tab to a picture, press Enter to select, then Tab to a category and press Enter. Escape cancels a selection. The activity works offline; source links need internet access.
